name: How long does interior painting usually take?
description: Painting duration varies by project size and complexity, from a few days for a room to over a week for an entire home.

mainEntity.name: How long does interior painting usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of interior painting depends on several factors, including the size of the area, the condition of the walls, the type of paint used, and the complexity of the project. A single room might take 1-2 days, while an entire home could range from 3-7 days or more. We provide a projected timeline with our estimate after assessing your specific project needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painting duration varies by project size and complexity, from a few days for a room to over a week for an entire home.
